events.title: Karnivool — In Verses Tour
events.description: Progressive rock band Karnivool performs their In Verses tour at the outdoor Riverstage venue. Expect a high-energy set featuring their signature complex and atmospheric soundscapes.

events.title: The Music of Video Games — Queensland Symphony Orchestra
events.description: The Queensland Symphony Orchestra presents a symphonic exploration of iconic video game soundtracks in a formal concert setting. This event showcases the intricate arrangement of gaming music for a full orchestra.

events.title: The Music of Video Games — Queensland Symphony Orchestra
events.description: An afternoon matinee performance by the Queensland Symphony Orchestra featuring orchestral arrangements of popular video game scores.

events.title: Silversun Pickups (Tenterhooks AUS/NZ Tour)
events.location: The Tivoli, 52 Costin St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: LA-based indie rock band Silversun Pickups bring their Tenterhooks tour to Brisbane's historic Tivoli venue. Known for their dense guitar layers and alternative rock aesthetic.

events.title: Chillinit — The Last Leg Tour
events.location: The Tivoli, 52 Costin St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Australian rapper Chillinit performs at The Tivoli as part of his national tour. Expect a high-tempo hip-hop performance from one of the country's most prominent genre artists.

events.title: The Graeme Norris Sextet
events.location: JMI Live, 10 Exhibition St, Bowen Hills
events.description: A jazz performance by the Graeme Norris Sextet held at the Jazz Music Institute's dedicated live venue. A focused, intimate evening of live jazz musicianship.

events.title: Hot Toddies: Special Features (Triffid Sundays)
events.description: A live music showcase featuring Hot Toddies at The Triffid, a converted hangar venue known for supporting local and indie music scenes.

events.title: Michael Night: A Michael Jackson Club Night
events.description: A themed club night dedicated to the music of Michael Jackson, featuring DJ sets and a tribute-style atmosphere at The Triffid.

events.title: Permission Granted — Tom Thum & Tnee Dyer
events.description: Internationally renowned beatboxer Tom Thum collaborates with Tnee Dyer for an experimental performance at QPAC's Cremorne Theatre. A showcase of vocal dexterity and creative sound design.

events.title: The Rockefeller Frequency, Che Arthur (USA), Chestr — DJ sets by members of Silversun Pickups
events.location: The Brightside, 27 Warner St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: An indie and alternative showcase at The Brightside featuring local and international bands with guest DJ sets from members of Silversun Pickups.

events.title: Barrel Hall Jazz Club (Felons Barrel Hall)
events.location: Felons Barrel Hall, 5 Boundary St, Brisbane
events.source: Barrel Hall Jazz Club / Felons Barrel Hall
events.description: A weekly recurring jazz club session held at Felons Barrel Hall, emphasizing live performance in an open, industrial-style brewery space.

events.title: NIRVANNA (USA) — Tribute to Nirvana
events.description: A tribute concert performed by the American Nirvana tribute band NIRVANNA, hosted at the Crowbar rock venue in Fortitude Valley.

events.title: Candlelight: Coldplay & Imagine Dragons (string quartet by candlelight)
events.location: Saint John's Anglican Cathedral, Brisbane City
events.description: An atmospheric concert featuring a string quartet performing popular hits by Coldplay and Imagine Dragons inside the historic Saint John's Cathedral, illuminated by thousands of candles.

events.title: Candlelight: Back in Black (AC/DC tribute, strings)
events.location: Saint John's Anglican Cathedral, Brisbane City
events.description: A unique string quartet interpretation of the AC/DC album 'Back in Black', performed in the candlelit surroundings of Saint John's Anglican Cathedral.

events.title: Keys to Life — Jayson Gillham & Iyad Sughayer
events.description: A piano recital featuring Jayson Gillham and Iyad Sughayer performing at QPAC's Concert Hall, focusing on classical piano repertoire.
